rows.s_sql:
SET @prov_c := '%s'; SET @id:= '%s'; SET @cat_id := '%s'; SET @send := IF((SELECT active FROM sys_report WHERE cat_id = @cat_id and id = @id )=1,0,2); SET @b_year:=(SELECT yearprocess FROM pk_byear LIMIT 1); SET @start_d:=concat(@b_year-1,'1001'); SET @end_d:=concat(@b_year,'0930'); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS s_asthma_admit( id varchar(32) NOT NULL, hospcode varchar(5) NOT NULL, areacode varchar(8) NOT NULL, flag_sent varchar(1) DEFAULT NULL, date_com varchar(14) DEFAULT NULL, b_year varchar(4) NOT NULL, target2 int(9) DEFAULT 0, target1 int(9) DEFAULT 0, target int(9) DEFAULT 0, result int(9) DEFAULT 0, resultq1 int(9) DEFAULT 0, resultq2 int(9) DEFAULT 0, resultq3 int(9) DEFAULT 0, resultq4 int(9) DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (id,hospcode,areacode,b_year), KEY (hospcode), KEY (areacode), KEY (b_year) ) ENGINE=MyISAM DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8; DELETE FROM s_asthma_admit WHERE id=@id AND b_year=(@b_year+543); /*รายคนคิดรายใหม่*/ DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS t_asthma ; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t_asthma ( b_year VARCHAR(4), min_date_serv date, a_code text, a_q1 DECIMAL(1) DEFAULT 0, a_q2 DECIMAL(1) DEFAULT 0, a_q3 DECIMAL(1) DEFAULT 0, a_q4 DECIMAL(1) DEFAULT 0, result DECIMAL(1) DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(hospcode,cid), KEY(hospcode,cid), KEY(cid) ) ENGINE=myisam IGNORE AS SELECT hospcode,pid,cid ,SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT b_year ORDER BY b_year ASC),',',1) b_year ,SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT min_date_serv ORDER BY b_year ASC),',',1) min_date_serv ,SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT diagcode ORDER BY b_year ASC),',',1) diagcode ,SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT diagtype ORDER BY b_year ASC),',',1) diagtype ,null as a_code ,0 as a_q1 ,0 as a_q2 ,0 as a_q3 ,0 as a_q4 ,0 as result FROM tmp_asthma GROUP BY hospcode,cid; DROP TEMPORARY TABLE IF EXISTS t_asthma_admit ; CREATE TEMPORARY TABLE IF NOT EXISTS t_asthma_admit ( PRIMARY KEY(hospcode,pid,cid,q), KEY(cid,q) ) ENGINE=myisam IGNORE AS SELECT o.HOSPCODE,o.PID,o.cid,QUARTER(datetime_disch)+1 as q ,SUBSTR(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT o.datetime_disch ORDER BY date(o.datetime_disch) ASC),1,10) min_date_admit ,GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT('{"DATETIME_DISCH":"',o.datetime_disch,'","DIAGCODE":"',o.diagcode ,'","DIAGTYPE":"',o.diagtype,'"}') ORDER BY date(o.datetime_disch) SEPARATOR '
,') as g_code FROM tmp_diag_ipd o INNER JOIN chospital h ON o.hospcode=h.hoscode AND h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,15) INNER JOIN t_person_db p ON o.HOSPCODE=p.HOSPCODE AND o.PID=p.PID WHERE SUBSTR(o.diagcode,1,3) IN('J45', 'J46') AND date(o.datetime_disch) BETWEEN @start_d AND @end_d AND o.DIAGTYPE IN(1) GROUP BY o.HOSPCODE,o.cid,QUARTER(datetime_disch)+1; UPDATE t_asthma_admit o SET o.q=1 WHERE o.q=5; UPDATE t_asthma o INNER JOIN t_asthma_admit i ON o.hospcode=i.hospcode AND o.pid=i.pid SET o.a_q1=1 WHERE i.q=1; UPDATE t_asthma o INNER JOIN t_asthma_admit i ON o.hospcode=i.hospcode AND o.pid=i.pid SET o.a_q2=1 WHERE i.q=2; UPDATE t_asthma o INNER JOIN t_asthma_admit i ON o.hospcode=i.hospcode AND o.pid=i.pid SET o.a_q3=1 WHERE i.q=3; UPDATE t_asthma o INNER JOIN t_asthma_admit i ON o.hospcode=i.hospcode AND o.pid=i.pid SET o.a_q4=1 WHERE i.q=4; UPDATE t_asthma o INNER JOIN t_asthma_admit i ON o.hospcode=i.hospcode AND o.pid=i.pid SET o.a_code=i.g_code ,o.result=1; INSERT IGNORE INTO s_asthma_admit SELECT @id,h.hoscode,concat(h.provcode,SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.distcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.subdistcode),-2),SUBSTR(CONCAT('00',h.mu),-2)) as areacode ,@send,DATE_FORMAT(now(),'%Y%m%d%H%i%s') as d_com,@b_year+543 as b_year ,COUNT(DISTINCT if(t.b_year =(@b_year-1),concat(t.HOSPCODE,'-',t.pid),null )) as target2 ,COUNT(DISTINCT if(t.b_year =@b_year,concat(t.HOSPCODE,'-',t.pid),null )) as target1 ,COUNT(DISTINCT if(t.b_year =(@b_year-1) OR t.b_year =@b_year ,concat(t.HOSPCODE,'-',t.pid),null )) as target ,COUNT(DISTINCT if(t.result=1,concat(t.HOSPCODE,'-',t.pid),null )) as result ,COUNT(DISTINCT if(t.a_q1=1,concat(t.HOSPCODE,'-',t.pid),null )) as resultq1 ,COUNT(DISTINCT if(t.a_q2=1,concat(t.HOSPCODE,'-',t.pid),null )) as resultq2 ,COUNT(DISTINCT if(t.a_q3=1,concat(t.HOSPCODE,'-',t.pid),null )) as resultq3 ,COUNT(DISTINCT if(t.a_q4=1,concat(t.HOSPCODE,'-',t.pid),null )) as resultq4 FROM t_asthma t INNER JOIN chospital h ON t.hospcode=h.hoscode GROUP BY h.hoscode;

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code ,h.zone_name as a_name, SUM("target2") as "target2" ,SUM("target1") as "target1" ,SUM("target") as "target" ,SUM("result") as "result" ,SUM("resultq1") as "resultq1" ,SUM("resultq2") as "resultq2" ,SUM("resultq3") as "resultq3" ,SUM("resultq4") as "resultq4"  FROM chospital_regis as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} LEFT JOIN cmastercup ON s.hospcode = cmastercup.hsub WHERE (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) AND (cmastercup.hsub IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) GROUP BY h.zone_code,h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

hospital.label: โรงพยาบาล
hospital.query: SELECT h.hoscode as a_code ,concat(h.hoscode,':',h.hosname) as a_name ,   		 SUM(target2) as target2     		 ,SUM(target1) as target1     		 ,SUM(target) as target     		 ,SUM(result) as result 			,SUM(resultq1) as resultq1 			,SUM(resultq2) as resultq2 			,SUM(resultq3) as resultq3 			,SUM(resultq4) as resultq4  FROM chospital as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode=s.hospcode AND s.b_year={{YEAR}} AND {{YYMMFREEZE}} LEFT JOIN ccmihosp ON s.hospcode = ccmihosp.hcode AND ccmihosp.byear = {{YEAR}} WHERE h.hostype IN(5,6,7,11,12,15) AND h.hdc_regist=1 AND (h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}}) AND (h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}}) AND (h.amp_code = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.tmb_code = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SUBDISTRICT_FULL_CODE}}) AND (h.dep = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{DEPARTMENT_CODE}}) AND (h.mcode IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{ORGANIZATION_TYPE}})) AND (h.mcode IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{MINISTRY_CODE}})) AND (h.hoscode IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}}) or 'ALL' IN ({{HOSPITAL_CODE}})) AND (ccmihosp.splevel = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{SERVICE_PLAN_CODE}}) GROUP BY 1
